name: Standard Meeting Notes
description: Summary, decisions, action items and open questions, combining your notes with the transcript.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: Provide a brief, one-paragraph executive summary of the meeting, giving priority to the points captured in the user's notes.

sections.title: Key Decisions
sections.instruction: List only decisions that were explicitly agreed in the transcript or recorded in the user's notes. Do not turn proposals or opinions into decisions.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: List each task that someone committed to. Owner: only a person explicitly named as responsible in the source, otherwise "Unassigned". Due: only a date or time explicitly stated in the source, otherwise "Not specified". Include the supporting transcript quote or note and its timestamp when available.
sections.item_format:
| **Owner** | Task | Due | Source (quote or note) | Timestamp |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

sections.title: Open Questions
sections.instruction: List questions raised that were not resolved during the meeting.

sections.title: Discussion Highlights
sections.instruction: Summarize the main topics of discussion, key arguments, and important insights.
